character: Lower, quieter hamlet of Les Menuires at 1,700m. Designed by Jean-Marc Legrand with striking triangular architecture. More relaxed than central Les Menuires. Direct piste access. Shuttle to Les Menuires centre. Good-value accommodation.
dining: Mountain restaurants including L'Ekrin (fine dining elevated).
shopping: Small convenience store, bakery, ski rental.
apres_scene: Quiet. Bars in Les Menuires centre via shuttle (10 min).
activities_nearby: Direct access to 3 Vallées pistes. Reberty gondola to high altitude. Shuttle to Les Menuires centre for pool, ice rink, bowling.
